[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-17x[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]`:` Command Line: run sase commands from the TUI[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`;` opens the Command Palette and `:` opens a new bottom-anchored [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Command Line panel. In the panel, users type `sase` commands with [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]better completion than any shell offers: selection-aware, fuzzy, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]documented and grammar-checked. Output streams inline. Every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]command runs as a durable, tagged proc that keeps running after the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]panel is hidden, shows up in Admin Center → Procs, and returns to [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the transcript when the panel reopens.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]12[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Output color contract[/bold #D7AFFF]                                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]color-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]color-contract: add one shared color resolver (NO_COLOR, then [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]FORCE_COLOR/CLICOLOR_FORCE, then isatty). Adopt it in the bead renderers[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and every other stdout color branch, so a piped `sase` child renders in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]color the way a terminal does.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Command Line spec contract[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]spec-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]spec-contract: extend the completion spec with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]required/metavar/default/value_hint and per-command run policy, writes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and confirms data. Add `sase completion spec -d/--descriptions` and an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity-keyed on-disk spec cache that is built in a subprocess.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Value-kind coverage and ratchet[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]kind-coverage[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spec-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]kind-coverage: add GATE, TOOL_RUN and TASK_TYPE value kinds with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]providers, annotate the unkinded entity slots, and add a coverage [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ratchet test. The test requires every non-hidden value slot to be [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kinded, to have choices, or to carry a free-form value_hint.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Command-line proc tag and retention bucket[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]proc-retention[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]proc-retention: in sase-core, give finished procs tagged `command-line` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]their own retention bucket of 50 so they never evict operational proc [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]history. Export the tag and limit through the binding and move sase's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core revision pin.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase-core CommandLineGrammar resolver[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]line-resolver[dim] · [dim][/dim]after spec-contract, proc-retention[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]line-resolver: build a frozen `CommandLineGrammar` handle in sase-core [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that parses the spec JSON once. Per keystroke it returns tokens, slot, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostics, signature, run policy and fuzzy-ranked candidates. Add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Python adapter in sase and move the revision pin.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Command-line proc plumbing[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]proc-plumbing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after proc-retention[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]proc-plumbing: add `submit_command_line_proc` (a tagged ordinary proc [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with the output env contract and no operation), an observer exit watch, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-counted tails, an offset-based `ProcLogCursor`, `ObservedProc.tags` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with a Procs `tag:` query field, and an Admin Center proc focus target.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Command Line panel shell (beta flag)[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]panel-shell[dim] · [dim][/dim]after proc-plumbing[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]`open_command_line`, the bottom-anchored `CommandLineScreen` and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]app-held `CommandLineSession`, plus the working-context chip, a locked [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]history store with ghost text, submitting to procs, and streaming [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]transcript blocks. Add PNG goldens for the base states.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Transcript block interactions and lifecycle[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]transcript-blocks[dim] · [dim][/dim]after panel-shell[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]transcript-blocks: add NORMAL-mode block navigation with expand, pager, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kill, rerun, edit, copy, open-in-Procs and remove. Add completion toasts[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Grammar-aware completion popup and signature line[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]completion-popup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after panel-shell, line-resolver[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]<selection>" rows, a wide-terminal doc peek beside the popup, ctrl+r [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fuzzy history search in the popup, marked rows that fill variadic slots,[/#D7D7AF]
